<script>
    const notes = [
        { measure: 1, note: 'G2', duration: 1 },
        { measure: 1, note: 'D3', duration: 1 },
        { measure: 1, note: 'G3', duration: 0.5 },
        { measure: 1, note: 'Bb3', duration: 0.5 },
        { measure: 1, note: 'D3', duration: 0.5 },
        { measure: 1, note: 'G3', duration: 0.5 },
        { measure: 1, note: 'Bb3', duration: 0.5 },
        { measure: 1, note: 'D3', duration: 0.5 },
        // M2 is identical to M1
        { measure: 2, note: 'G2', duration: 1 },
        { measure: 2, note: 'D3', duration: 1 },
        { measure: 2, note: 'G3', duration: 0.5 },
        { measure: 2, note: 'Bb3', duration: 0.5 },
        { measure: 2, note: 'D3', duration: 0.5 },
        { measure: 2, note: 'G3', duration: 0.5 },
        { measure: 2, note: 'Bb3', duration: 0.5 },
        { measure: 2, note: 'D3', duration: 0.5 },
        // M3
        { measure: 3, note: 'D5', duration: 0.25 },
        { measure: 3, note: 'Eb5', duration: 0.25 },
        { measure: 3, note: 'F5', duration: 0.25 },
        { measure: 3, note: 'G5', duration: 0.25 },
        { measure: 3, note: 'A5', duration: 0.25 },
        { measure: 3, note: 'Bb5', duration: 0.25 },
        { measure: 3, note: 'C6', duration: 0.25 },
        { measure: 3, note: 'D6', duration: 0.25 },
        { measure: 3, note: 'D5', duration: 1 }
    ];

    const audioContext = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
    const keyMap = {
        'C2': 36, 'D2': 38, 'E2': 40, 'F2': 41, 'G2': 43, 'A2': 45, 'B2': 47,
        'C3': 48, 'D3': 50, 'E3': 52, 'F3': 53, 'G3': 55, 'A3': 57, 'B3': 59,
        'C4': 60, 'D4': 62, 'E4': 64, 'F4': 65, 'G4': 67, 'A4': 69, 'B4': 71,
        'C5': 72, 'D5': 74, 'E5': 76, 'F5': 77, 'G5': 79, 'A5': 81, 'Bb5': 83, 'C6': 84, 'D6': 86
    };

    function playNote(note, duration) {
        const oscillator = audioContext.createOscillator();
        oscillator.type = 'sine';
        oscillator.frequency.setValueAtTime(keyMap[note], audioContext.currentTime);
        oscillator.connect(audioContext.destination);
        oscillator.start();
        oscillator.stop(audioContext.currentTime + duration);
    }

    function highlightKey(note) {
        const key = document.querySelector(`.key[data-note="${note}"]`);
        if (key) {
            key.classList.add('active');
            setTimeout(() => key.classList.remove('active'), 1000); // Remove highlight after 1 second
        }
    }

    let currentNoteIndex = 0;
    function playNextNote() {
        if (currentNoteIndex < notes.length) {
            const note = notes[currentNoteIndex];
            playNote(note.note, note.duration);
            highlightKey(note.note);
            currentNoteIndex++;
            setTimeout(playNextNote, note.duration * 1000);
        }
    }

    document.querySelector('.play-button').addEventListener('click', () => {
        currentNoteIndex = 0; // Reset index when play button is clicked
        playNextNote();
    });
</script>
